evidence.green: REAL GAP FOUND AND FIXED. The cherry-picked seat read the notification tag from payload.spot_id. Nothing on the wire carries that key: the acceptance payload is { v, title, body, url, tag } and the production PlannedSend composed by plan-notifications.ts carries `tag` set to spot.spot_id. spot_id is a plan-side field, alongside endpoint_hash and ttl_seconds, that routes a send and never reaches the notification. Every aviso was therefore shown under the unreadable-payload fallback tag 'aviso', so two avisos of DIFFERENT spots would have replaced each other and the no-nagging rule this row states was inverted. The sibling lane's unit fixture masked it: VENAO_PAYLOAD declared spot_id and no tag, a shape nothing produces, so all eight of its unit tests passed against a seat reading the wrong key. Only the real reconciled oracle caught it.
